race.comment: CONSCIENCE (14) just found an in form mare better on resumption at Sandown Lakeside but ran well for second there and still has scope to improve. She has won over 1000m so back in trip looks okay if she can land close enough. SET ME LOOSE (11) is fresh for this. She was dominant first up at Seymour then worked home well enough last time behind a dominant leader. She can push on here and take catching. SALUTED (1) is an out-and-out 1000m horse, too fast here last time out in a BM70. Getting up in the weights but is racing very well and should go close again. NO LIMITATION (8) resumes today and was good in defeat when fresh last campaign. Can return in good order.
